title: Napoleon Crossing the Alps (Bonaparte franchissant les Alpes au Grand-Saint-Bernard), prime version

title: The School of Athens
collection: Apostolic Palace (Stanza della Segnatura), Vatican City
licence: Public Domain (PD-Art, author died 1520) + photo released CC0 1.0 by photographer
note: In-situ 2024 photo of the whole fresco with the surrounding arch ornament and a door frame at lower left. Cropped by box (62,46)-(1248,831) instead of crop.py to cut out the viewer arrows and counter; edges of the arch kept. Media Viewer shows Created: 1550 (metadata error).

title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji
collection: Metropolitan Museum of Art (JP1847, H. O. Havemeyer Collection)
note: Woodblock print (one impression, Met). Box-cropped (58,44)-(1250,831) to remove viewer arrows/counter: about 2% trimmed from each side and 5% from the top sky; the title cartouche and whole wave are kept.

title: The Death of Caesar
date: between 1859 and 1867 (signed MDCCCLIX, last digits abraded)
licence: Public Domain (PD-Art life+100; Walters released the reproduction into the public domain)
note: crop.py failed on this dark painting (picked an inner box), so box-cropped (58,32)-(1250,800): full height, about 4.5% trimmed from each side to remove the viewer arrows. Media Viewer shows Created: 1850 (metadata error).

title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival (detail: the Rainbow Bridge)
date: Northern Song dynasty, early 12th century (file page gives 1085)
note: Detail of the original scroll showing the wooden arch bridge. Box-cropped (58,90)-(1250,744) to remove viewer arrows; about 4.5% trimmed from each side. File page date 1085 is Zhang Zeduan birth year, not the painting date.

title: Mona Lisa (La Gioconda / La Joconde)

title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie, 1903 Nobel Prize portrait

title: Tribute Giraffe with Attendant
